ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Rot Spore Kit
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
FUNGALFOREST_RAID_MERGE_1 — the "raid" half of dissolving `BMT_FungalForest` (Biomes! Caverns) into the Rot (`design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/the_rot.md` §7b, owner ruling 2026-09-06: "raid this biome for its cool contents"). Ships the spore-warfare kit, fungal materials/terrain, two buildings, one research row, two drugs and nineteen flora species as our own `RUT_`-prefixed defs, ported field-for-field from the donor's 1.6 source (`vendor/mod_sources/BiomesCaverns_src`) per the absorption precedent (`Absorbed_KotorCore`). Art copied from the live Workshop install (steamapps/workshop/content/294100/2969748433) at matching texPath, not generated.
Two rulings on file (owner, 2026-09-06): `RUT_BlastpodShroom` -> chemfuel is WILD-ONLY, no sow tags for Jawa; `BMT_FungalPowerGenerator` is CUT, not ingested.
Decoupled from the donor where its own custom classes were involved: flora use vanilla `Plant`/`Plant` parent chains (not `BMT.BiomesPlant`), `BiomesCore.DefModExtensions.*` tuning extensions dropped, and `RUT_Skulltop`'s spore defense uses AlphaBiomes' own already-relied-upon `CompProperties_GasProducer` (field names verified against `vendor/mod_sources/AlphaBiomes_src`, same mechanism as `AB_AgariluxPrime`) instead of guessing at BiomesCore's own spore comp. One exception kept donor-dependent on purpose: `RUT_SporeCloud`'s `conditionClass` still points at `BiomesCaverns.GameCondition_SporeCloud` (`MayRequire="biomesteam.biomescaverns"`) — a full C# port is owed, tracked on `FUNGALFOREST_RAID_MERGE_1`, and this only matters once BiomesCaverns actually retires.
Fauna (thrumbungus the creature, fungal mantis, cave spider, etc.) is explicitly NOT ingested here — that admission rides `BIOME_FAUNA_ASSIGNMENT_SITTING_1` per the item's own scope split. `RUT_FungalMantisScythe`'s claw ingredient still names the donor's `BMT_FungalMantisClaw` pending that sitting.
